titulo: Pedir que + present subjunctive (asking someone to do something)
regla: To ask someone to do something: (indirect pronoun / a + person) + pedir que + present subjunctive, when pedir is in the present, present perfect or future: Le pido a Laura que venga. Que can't be dropped. Not preguntar.

bloques.texto: Use the **present subjunctive** when **pedir** is in the present, present progressive, present perfect, **ir a** or future.
The person you ask gets **a** and usually an indirect pronoun too: **le pido a Laura que...**
**Que** is required. And it's **pedir**, never **preguntar** (_to ask a question_).
Tip: **pedir** asks for actions; **preguntar** asks for information.

lista.es: Te pido que ==consideres== mi oferta con calma.
lista.en: I'm asking you to think my offer over carefully.

lista.es: Le estoy pidiendo que ==se case== conmigo.
lista.en: I'm asking her to marry me.

lista.es: Mi novio siempre me pide que ==sea== paciente con él.
lista.en: My boyfriend always asks me to be patient with him.

lista.es: ¿Por qué no le pides a tu mamá que te ==preste== dinero para el viaje?
lista.en: Why don't you ask your mom to lend you money for the trip?

lista.es: Gabriel le ha pedido a Luisa que ==se vaya== a vivir con él.
lista.en: Gabriel has asked Luisa to move in with him.

lista.es: Le voy a pedir a Clara que me ==invite== un café.
lista.en: I'm going to ask Clara to buy me a coffee.

lista.es: En el aeropuerto te van a pedir que ==muestres== el pasaporte.
lista.en: At the airport they'll ask you to show your passport.

filas.t: Mi novio me pregunta que sea paciente.
Mi novio me pide que sea paciente.
Pido mi hermano que me ayude.
Le pido a mi hermano que me ayude.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I'm asking you to listen to me._ (tú)
In Spanish: _Ask Juan to call me._ (tú)
lista.r: Pídele a Juan que me llame.

lista.p: Fix it: _Les pregunto que lleguen temprano._
